none: PAS CPAT-4AAF81: Early Medieval coin: silver penny of King Coenwulf of Mercia
contea di ritrovamento: Hertfordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A hammered silver penny of King Coenwulf of Mercia dating to the Early Medieval period (c. AD 796-821) struck by Æthelmod at Canterbury. The obverse depicts a legend reading COENVVLF REX arranged circumferentially around a central circle and an M (for Mercia) within it. The reverse depicts a voided Tribrach moline consisting of two lines that divides the name of the moneyer Æthelmod (EþELMOD),…
